issues.source_quote: Если вы нам понадобитесь… Вы ко мне приедете. Если мы Вам будем нужны… Я вызываю такси на своё имя.
issues.translation_quote: If we need you… You'll come to me. If you need us… I call a taxi in my own name.
issues.justification: Roles are reversed: the original is 'if we need you, I'll send a taxi; if you need us, you come to me'. The translation garbles the communication arrangement and its logic.

issues.source_quote: Оружие при Вас? Психическое... Вас услышат.
issues.translation_quote: Do you have your weapon? The psychiatric one... You'll be overheard.
issues.justification: 'Психическое' means 'psychological' (psychological weapon, as earlier), not 'psychiatric'. The joke and continuity are broken.

issues.source_quote: Это - я, я, я! Дэтси аин шматси? [Куда ты смотрел старый осёл?]
issues.translation_quote: Where were you looking, you old ass?
issues.justification: Minor, but main issue is elsewhere; kept for completeness of gibberish gloss. (Acceptable.)

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy your tickets by the stack, and you'll win... A water-pumping shack!
issues.justification: The rhyme is loosely preserved, but 'water-pumping shack' is awkward and the lottery-slogan jingle humor is weakened; 'Водокачку' as a ridiculous prize is not clearly funny.

issues.source_quote: Вам нужно обязательно встретиться с Вашим приятелем.
issues.translation_quote: You absolutely must meet with your friend.
issues.justification: Acceptable; no issue. (Placeholder omitted.)

issues.source_quote: Нет, мне надо посоветоваться с шефом! С начальством...
issues.translation_quote: No, I need to consult the boss! My superiors...
issues.justification: Acceptable overall, but the preceding 'Нет, на это я пойтить не могу' is rendered 'I ain't goin' for that', which is fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: куй железо, не отходя от кассы!
issues.translation_quote: strike the iron without leaving the till!
issues.justification: The boss's mangled-proverb catchphrase (blend of 'strike while the iron is hot' and 'don't leave the cash register') is rendered in a way that is understandable but clumsy; 'strike the iron' is not a natural English idiom, so the malapropism humor is weakened.

issues.source_quote: Как говорит наш дорогой шеф, в нашем деле гланое - этот самый реализм!
issues.translation_quote: As our dear boss says, in our business the main thing is that there realism!
issues.justification: 'Этот самый' is a comic verbal tic of the boss and the mispronounced 'гланое'; the English 'that there realism' sounds rustic rather than the gangster-pseudointellectual pomposity, flattening the character joke.

issues.source_quote: Фрис-стрит, рыбна улица, - Аптека «Чиканук»...
issues.translation_quote: Frith Street, Fish Street, - The "Chikanuk" pharmacy...
issues.justification: The deliberately mangled foreign-sounding phrase ('Фрис-стрит' / Free Street) is changed to 'Frith Street', altering the gag; 'рыбна улица' also loses its broken-language feel.

issues.source_quote: Нет, с ночёвкой не поеду, боюсь застудить.
issues.translation_quote: No, not overnight, I'm afraid it'll catch a chill.
issues.justification: 'It' is unclear; the original implies he fears catching a chill in the arm/cast. The pronoun makes the line confusing.

issues.source_quote: Тогда я тебя укушу! Кусай!
issues.translation_quote: Then I'll bite you! Go ahead, bite!
issues.justification: Acceptable; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Эти кретины уверяли, что он был без сознания...
issues.translation_quote: Those cretins swore he was unconscious...
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Нет, нет, нет, нет, нет! А я взял... Водку?
issues.translation_quote: No, no, no, no, no! Well, I am... Vodka?
issues.justification: Mistranslation of tense/meaning: 'I took (some)' - the line is 'But I've brought some...' followed by the guess 'Vodka?'. Also 'Well, I am...' is ungrammatical and unclear.

issues.source_quote: Ты зачем усы сбрил?
issues.translation_quote: Why'd you shave off your mustache?
issues.justification: Acceptable; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Водокачку
issues.translation_quote: A water-pumping shack
issues.justification: Duplicate; see above.

issues.source_quote: Ты меня уважаешь?
issues.translation_quote: Do you respect me?
issues.justification: Acceptable; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Как же можно с человека срезать гипс незаметно?
issues.translation_quote: How can you cut a cast off a man without him noticing?
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Вы в самодеятельности участвуете?
issues.translation_quote: Do you do amateur theatricals?
issues.justification: 'Самодеятельность' means amateur performance/talent shows; acceptable, but later 'no amateur theatricals' for 'без самодеятельности' (meaning 'no improvising/acting on your own initiative') mistranslates the idiom and loses the double meaning.

issues.source_quote: Семён Семёнович, ну давайте без самодеятельности!
issues.translation_quote: Semyon Semyonovich, come on, no amateur theatricals!
issues.justification: Here 'без самодеятельности' means 'no freelancing / stick to instructions'; 'amateur theatricals' makes no sense in context.

issues.source_quote: Но это не боевое, а скорее психологическое...
issues.translation_quote: It's not a real one, more of a psychological one...
issues.justification: Fine; but later 'psychiatric' is inconsistent (see above).

issues.source_quote: Пейте. Пейте, пейте...
issues.translation_quote: Drink. Drink, drink...
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Я думаю, Семён Семёныч, каждый человек способен на многое. Но, к сожалению, не каждый знает, на что он способен.
issues.translation_quote: I believe, Semyon Semyonych, every person is capable of a great deal.
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Такова «сё ля ви», как говорят у них...
issues.translation_quote: Such is "c'est la vie", as they say over there...
issues.justification: The Russian deliberately misspells/mangles 'сё ля ви' with a feminine 'такова'; the translation loses the comic Russified quality, but it's minor.

issues.source_quote: Читали в «Неделе», отдел для, дома для семьи...
issues.translation_quote: Did you read in "Nedelya", the section for, the home and family...
issues.justification: Culturally specific reference to the Soviet newspaper 'Nedelya' is left opaque without any cue; for English viewers it reads as meaningless.

issues.source_quote: Пока... Придёт время, ты всё узнаешь
issues.translation_quote: Yet... The time will come, you'll know everything…
issues.justification: 'Пока' here means 'for now'; 'Yet...' is an awkward rendering.

issues.source_quote: туалэт, типа сортир
issues.translation_quote: toilette, type: latrine
issues.justification: 'Toilette' is a mistranslation of the comic mispronunciation; 'type: latrine' is stilted and doesn't convey the pompous-vulgar mixing.

issues.source_quote: пыхты
issues.translation_quote: fur tree
issues.justification: The villain's mispronounced 'пыхта' (fir) is rendered as 'fur tree', then corrected to 'fir tree'; inconsistent.

issues.source_quote: Строго на север, порядка... 50-ти метров
issues.translation_quote: Due north, approximately... 50 meters
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: с бесчувственного тела
issues.translation_quote: off an unconscious body
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Козлодоев... Козадоев! Казладоев!
issues.translation_quote: Kozlodoyev... Kozadoyev! Kozzlodoyev!
issues.justification: The running gag is that Lyolik deliberately mangles the name into 'Козлодоев' (goat-milker/'kozel' insult); no cue conveys it, so the insult and joke are lost on English viewers.

issues.source_quote: Сеня, давай махнём на рыбалку а?
issues.translation_quote: Sen, how about we go fishing, eh?
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках!
issues.translation_quote: Drop dead! May I see you in yer coffin, in white slippers!
issues.justification: The Odessa/Yiddish-inflected curse speech is flattened into generic dialect; 'yer' doesn't convey the characteristic accent and flavor.

issues.source_quote: Не-к... А кока-колу пил? ... К-к... [фигня]
issues.translation_quote: P-pfft... [rubbish]
issues.justification: Bracketed gloss in a spoken line is awkward; 'rubbish' is British and mismatches the rest of the American register.

issues.source_quote: ЖЭКа
issues.translation_quote: housing office
issues.justification: Acceptable, but 'Красном уголке' rendered as 'Red Corner' without explanation is opaque.

issues.source_quote: Хорошо бы… пива…
issues.translation_quote: I'd rather have… a beer…
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Нью-Йорк-город контрастов
issues.translation_quote: "New York — City of Contrasts"
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Там живут несчастные люди-дикари
issues.translation_quote: Hapless savage people live upon its shore
issues.justification: Song translation drifts: lines like 'Kids and grown-ups waste away for nothing' lose rhyme, and 'And so, from dusk till dawn' restructures stanza; rhyme scheme is inconsistent across the song.

issues.source_quote: Им бы понедельники взять и отменить
issues.translation_quote: If only they could cancel Mondays for all time
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: трынь траву
issues.translation_quote: who-cares grass
issues.justification: 'Трынь-трава' is an idiom ('who cares') tied to the magic herb; 'who-cares grass' is a clever solution, but 'Все напасти нам будут трынь трава' becoming 'all our woes will be who-cares grass' is nonsensical and loses the idiom.

issues.source_quote: Вылитый Володька Трынкин!
issues.translation_quote: The spitting image of Volodka Trynkin!
issues.justification: Fine; the surname plays on 'трынь-трава' but that is lost, minor.

issues.source_quote: Шампанское по утрам пьют или аристократы, или дегенераты!
issues.translation_quote: Champagne in the morning is drunk by either aristocrats or degenerates!
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Пока что - задаток.
issues.translation_quote: For now — a down payment.
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Двухкоечный нумер... оплачен!
issues.translation_quote: A twin-bed numbah... paid for!
issues.justification: Fine; the accent rendering is inconsistent but acceptable.

issues.source_quote: Девять ноль-ноль...
issues.translation_quote: Twenty-one hundred...
issues.justification: Source says 'nine hundred' (09:00) though earlier appointment was nine o'clock; translator changed to 21:00 without basis, introducing a discrepancy.

issues.source_quote: Отшпилилась!
issues.translation_quote: It came unpinned!
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Не виноватая я! Он сам пришёл!
issues.translation_quote: Ain't my fault! He came by hisself!
issues.justification: Fine register choice; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Товарищ старший лейтенант, толко прошу Вас, все ценности принять по описи!
issues.translation_quote: Comrade Senior Lieutenant, I only ask you, take all the valuables against an inventory!
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Обои!... Убью!
issues.translation_quote: Both of you!... I'll kill you!
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Усё так, как условились.
issues.translation_quote: 'S all like we agreed.
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Геша, ты ушёл бы от такой женщины? Я - нет, но он - верный муж!
issues.translation_quote: Gesha, would you leave a woman like that? Me — no, but he's a faithful husband!
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Лёлик, но это же не эстетично... Зато дёшево, надёжно и практично!
issues.translation_quote: Lyolik, but that's not very artistic... But it's cheap, reliable and realistic!
issues.justification: 'Эстетично' is rendered as 'artistic' and 'практично' as 'realistic', both inaccurate; 'aesthetic' and 'practical' are the correct meanings.

issues.source_quote: Для эстетики.
issues.translation_quote: For aesthetics.
issues.justification: Fine; but inconsistent with 'artistic' rendering of same root elsewhere.

issues.source_quote: Тебя... Нет, нет, не надо, я сам... Деньги! ... Новыми?
issues.translation_quote: New rubles?
issues.justification: The joke about the 1961 currency reform (new vs old rubles) is left unexplained; the 'Новыми?' question reads as odd.

issues.source_quote: Идиот! Тьфу!
issues.translation_quote: Idiot! Pah!
issues.justification: 'Pah!' is archaic for an energetic colloquial exclamation.

issues.source_quote: Летять уткы… Летять у... утки... и-и два-а гуся-я...
issues.translation_quote: The ducks are flyin'… The d... ducks are flyin'... and-and two-o gee-eese...
issues.justification: The well-known Soviet song ('Летят утки') is paraphrased in dialect with no recognizable song feel; cultural reference diluted.
